lineage.pack_rule: only status=measured bands pack to shipped cells; seed bands (confidence 0.0) pack to NOTHING (generator refuses that version until confirm_law upgrades the row)
laws: rule10 version-keying: no game names/offsets/sha keys
labels are image-relative provenance of the measurement instance; transferable facts are shapes/offsets/patterns/orders only
base_policy: live base observation required (ASLR); generator emits base_status

provenance.note: Engine-level facts ONLY. No game names, title-ids, or per-game offsets may appear anywhere in this file (Rule 10; enforced by phasea-tools/release_audit.py against outputs/2026-10-08-l25-prep/tables).
provenance.measurement: measured once on the Mac against per-version engine material; never per game

detection.note: The 244-marker engine_version table becomes this per-version presence vector; the runtime scans the loaded image under admission and reproduces engine_match.py's cost solve.
triage_markers: <16 widest-coverage ungated marker strings, verbatim from the marker pack>

expected_presence.note: for this (version, config, stats) cell: which markers the cost solve expects present/absent; runtime computes cost against the LIVE presence vector and emits the margin

scan_envelope.budget_ms: shared with the existing admission budget (kAdmissionBudgetMs class; the generator runs INSIDE consume_required_slot_seeds' budget regime, never beside it)
scan_envelope.refusal: any anchor above max_candidates, or pattern extraction outside a classified readable span, or budget expiry => generation refuses (fail-closed; identical semantics to seed_refused)

walk the chunked TUObjectArray shape from structures.TUObjectArray with bounded reads; only a candidate passing the shape walk becomes the pin

anchors.probe_note: patternsleuth 9-pattern set scored 0/9 image-wide on the measured instance (compiler idiom drift): probes corroborate, NEVER gate; a probe miss is not a refusal

anchors.probe_note: patternsleuth 5-pattern set scored 0/14-store image-wide on the measured instance: probes corroborate, NEVER gate
